doc: NUMPY FLOAT32 ARTIFACT (a trap, not a model property): a CONSTANT float32 field of 7 values 0.1. The float32 mean (a sequential float32 sum of 7 values, then a float32 division by 7) is one ulp above 0.1f (7.45e-9), so v - mean = -7.45e-9 everywhere, the float32 std is 7.45e-9 > 0, the fallback is NOT taken and the result is -1 everywhere, not 0. The same constant with 8 or 16 values gives 0 (the unrolled pairwise sum is exact there), and with 64 values gives -1 again, so the outcome depends on the size and on float32 accumulation. A port that accumulates mean and std in float64 returns 0 for this input; a port that sums in float32, left to right, for n < 8 reproduces -1. The generator never standardizes a constant field, so a port may skip this case with that reason. Exact.
